simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: מַכְנַדְבַי (Maknadbay) means Maknadbai , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Ezra 10 40.

definitions.full: H4367. Maknadbay מַכְנַדְּבַי proper name, masculine one of those who had taken strange wives Ezra 10:40 (Gray Expos. Times, Feb. 1889, p. 233 proposes מכרנבו = possession of Nebo ); ᵐ5 Μαξαδναβου , A Μαχναδααβου ; ᵐ5 L Ναδαβου .
definitions.rootNote: from 4100 and 5068 with a particle interposed; what (is) like (a) liberal (man) ?;
